snippet.title: GLYPHS Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
GLYPHS is an upcoming difficult puzzle-platformer about exploration and persistence to release May 30th.
WISHLIST AT https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616230/GLYPHS/

All footage and OST is created by Vortex Bros, but is subject to change.

The pre-release is available to play on https://vortex-bros.itch.io/glyphs
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/gaxdJX7RQx
Speedrun: https://www.speedrun.com/Glyphs

Minor Epilepsy??
